en: Dependent on a wholesome state belonging to the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), a non-wholesome state not belonging to the sense-sphere arises by way of root condition (hetupaccaya).
Dependent on a wholesome state not belonging to the sense-sphere, a non-wholesome state not belonging to the sense-sphere arises by way of root condition.
There are two [instances] for root; ... pe ... there are two for non-disappearance (avigata).

Dependent on a wholesome state of the sense-sphere, a non-wholesome state that is not of the sense-sphere arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition: one. (The indeterminate root has two conditions.)
